newsitem.title: USA: GE unit FGIC net income falls 10 percent in Q1.
newsitem.headline: GE unit FGIC net income falls 10 percent in Q1.

text.p: First quarter net income for Financial Guaranty Insurance Co, a unit of General Electric Co's GE Capital Services, fell 10 percent in first quarter 1997 to $43.6 million, according to an official filing by the company.
The income statement, submitted to the Nebraska Department of Insurance and obtained by Reuters, said net income for the same period in 1996 was $48.4 million.
FGIC announced earlier this year it would stop releasing its quarterly earnings information to the general public, in keeping with a policy in effect for other subsidiaries of GE Capital.
FGIC said, however, it would continue releasing the information to regulators, rating agencies and other official entities.
FGIC's Nebraska filing also indicates that premiums earned in the first quarter dropped 18 percent to $27 million. Investment gains rose to $37.7 million from $36.1 million.
Policyholders' surplus as of March 31, 1997 rose to $1.12 billion from $1.03 billion on Dec. 31, 1996.
